name: Roma
long_description:
Roma is the to-do list that does itself. Two of our three founders have been through YC before: Jan built Loom (W12, acquired by Dropbox) and Tobi built Senic (S13, acquired by Gira).

Most of the work we do starts and ends with a task. So we're rebuilding something everyone already uses: the to-do list that becomes your everyday assistant, the one place that already knows everything you need done.

launches.title: Roma: The to-do list that does itself
launches.tagline: We're reinventing the to-do list so it does the work for you.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Roma is the to-do list that does itself. It's the original productivity tool reinvented. The task list you already keep, remade so the tasks actually get done.

<https://youtu.be/6bEw1OBRTkU>

### The original

From pen and paper to apps on a phone, the to-do list has stood the test of time. It's the original productivity tool, and the one tool everyone has used at least once.

You can't say that about many things, especially as technology advances. But whether you have one task or seventeen, there's a to-do list in your head, in your pocket, or on your desk right now.

Since the beginning, all to-do lists have made the same promise: write the task down so you can stop worrying about it. The catch is that you always have to come back and do it yourself. So the tasks pile up.

### The problem

When AI became smart enough to actually help you get things done, we did what a lot of people did and built our own agents. It was hard. It took forever. Even when it worked, it didn't work the way we wanted. 

Then the AI Assistants arrived, promising to handle things for you. People love them. That's the clearest sign the demand is there.

But the work never stay put. It lives in one chat, then another, then an inbox, then a doc somewhere. Instead of doing the work, you're tracking the work down.

### Reinventing the to-do list

That's why we're playing the long game and not building another assistant. We're reinventing the original productivity tool: the to-do list.

**Roma is the to-do list that does itself.** 

That sounds possible with AI, but it's really hard to get right. You have to be able to add a task for anything and the system has to figure out what you meant, get to work on multiple things in the background, sort it into the right project, and surface it at exactly the right time. 

So that's where we spent most of our time building Roma. Underneath Roma is a harness built to take a task from idea to execution. And on top, it feels as simple and light as the to-do list that you're used to. 

### What it feels like

Roma gets real tasks done. But what you notice first is what it does to your mind. You realize you haven't thought about that one task in hours, because it's being handled. You walk into a meeting prepared. You close your laptop with a clear head.

### Why us

We're Jan, Tobi, and Cody. Jan previously built Loom (YC W12, acquired by Dropbox), and Tobi built Senic (YC S13, acquired by Gira). 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117892&key=user_uploads/24212/d1545e35-9497-4e2f-a4f9-34f6420684e6)

### Where this goes

We're only scratching the surface of what Roma can do. As Roma takes on more of your work, the to-do list becomes the place you hand off everything. 

We're going to connect with the apps and assistants you're already using. So whatever you're working on, Roma becomes the center of how it gets done. 

We're only scratching the surface of what Roma can do, and we can't wait to hear what you think.\
\
**Try Roma:**

* Website: <https://roma.app>
* Mac & iOS: <https://roma.app/download>

We're very excited to hear what you all think!
